caption: This shoyu ramen features a golden-brown, glossy broth with floating nori, chashu pork, menma, and naruto. Served in a white ceramic bowl with a glossy rim, it rests on a dark wooden table with visible grain.

segments_info.text: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle reflections near the bowl's edge.
The chashu pork is a round, golden-brown slice with a slightly crispy surface and visible marbling.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly rough surface with visible veins.
The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is golden-brown, glossy, and clear, with thin noodles submerged and floating ingredients visible.
Menma bamboo shoots appear as golden-brown, slightly translucent, elongated strips with a fibrous texture and faint surface ridges.
White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, subtly textured rim.
Naruto fish cake: pale pink swirls in translucent white, smooth surface with slight sheen and faint specks.
